hypotheses.construction_plan: Start from the two-parameter kernel K(a,b). The branch K(n,m) is the instance with a=n and b=m; the branch K(n,n) is the diagonal specialization a=n and b=n.
required_assumptions: K is defined for all relevant pairs, including the diagonal a=b
hypotheses.rationale: The non-identical branches are two evaluations of the same symbolic kernel K under different argument assignments; the piecewise condition selects the diagonal specialization when n equals m.
